description: X-tee andmeteenuste kataloog is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. The X-tee service catalogue is available on page and consists of two parts: - List of subsystems registered on X-Road in the "Subsystems" section. - Technical specifications for data services used on X-Road in the "Services" section. Coverage: Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. The portal shows the English title as "X-Road Data Services Directory" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Riigi Infosüsteemi Amet. Its keywords include data registers, andmebaasid, andmehaldus, andmeregistrid, data control, databases. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
